# Lucide originals

Unmodified SVGs copied from `lucide-icons/lucide` revision
`500620a2e8123f8d1db191538886dc0c223f69a9`, under `icons/<name>.svg`.
Upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/500620a2e8123f8d1db191538886dc0c223f69a9/icons

Tests compare every shipped interface SVG against these originals. Runtime HTML
adds only classes, `data-lucide` and accessibility attributes. CSS controls the
display size, not geometry or stroke proportions. Status variants are separate
SVGs rather than unrelated paths combined into one icon.

The license is shipped in `src/icons/LUCIDE-LICENSE`. These fixtures stay out of
the extension ZIP. There is no icon package or runtime loader.
